visualCharacteristics.purpose: Promotional cards linking to related resources, each with a photo above a dark panel
visualCharacteristics.card: photo on top, dark plum solid panel below
visualCharacteristics.text: centered H3, description and red button
visualCharacteristics.notes: Photo on top, dark solid panel below with centered title, description and button. Cards flow and wrap in a responsive grid.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: [image | H3 title + paragraph + link]

usage: Use for a small set of promotional cards pointing to related pages, typically under an 'Additional resources' heading.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any image-topped promo cards with a dark text panel and a single call to action. Use the plain cards block for light, bordered cards.
